items.prompt: Show quarter past 4 on the clock.
hints: Quarter past means 15 minutes after the hour.
The short hand is just past 4.
items.explanation: At quarter past 4 the long hand is on 3 and the short hand is just past 4.

items.prompt: Show 25 minutes past 9 on the clock.
hints: Each number on the clock is 5 minutes.
items.explanation: 25 minutes past 9 means the long hand is on 5 and the short hand is just past 9.
